turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Banerjee?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Anjali from City Care Hospital in Nagpur. I am calling regarding your cardiologist appointment for Tuesday.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh yes, I remember. Is everything okay with the timing?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it is confirmed for 10:30 AM. Also, your blood reports are ready for pickup at the front desk.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. Will I have to pay for the tests now over the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, no, please do not pay anything now. You can settle the bill at the counter when you visit.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, thank you. I was worried because the total estimate was quite high, nearly one lakh rupees.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is correct for the full procedure package, but we will handle all payments in person at the clinic.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, that is a relief. I will be there on Tuesday morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please remember to bring your previous prescriptions. We will see you then.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I will keep them ready. Thank you, Anjali.
